messages.subject: Project Quartz — negotiation strategy ahead of first mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Ahead of issuing the licence v1, my thoughts on where Brandt will push: (1) territory - they want worldwide ex-NA, we should be willing to land at EEA/UK/Switzerland; (2) royalty - they'll attack 6.5%, our floor should be 5.0% with a modest upfront reduction; (3) liability cap - our v1 is generous (greater of £5m / fees), expect them to want it tied to fees paid in the preceding 12 months. The FTO note is nearly final - low risk. Let's hold firm on exclusivity and the minimum royalties.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Quartz — negotiation strategy ahead of first mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed. I'd trade upfront for royalty: if they want 6.5% down, we can move the upfront from £1.5m to £1.25m but hold royalty at 5.0%. Don't give exclusivity ground on the Verdant carve-out - that goes in a side letter, not the licence body.

Sarah
